source.raw_retention: bounded prefetch of at most 8 one-minute responses in memory, consumed strictly in offset order and discarded immediately; only bounded runtime-test samples may be retained
source.snapshot_runtime_result: arbitrary minute offsets do not receive full_snapshot; each date must replay once from the 00:00 generated snapshot through the end of the last selected window

split_policy.test_access_rule: test-derived labels, decompositions, and metrics are not read until structural alpha is frozen after validation

placement_policy.book_entry: current reconstructed BBO immediately before first lifecycle event at or after trigger
placement_policy.censoring: retain unresolved expiration-boundary observations as CENSORED; never impute a large fill time

l3_truth.sequence_rule: generated full_snapshot initializes an acquisition segment; buffered sequence > snapshot sequence is replayed; lifecycle sequences must be contiguous within each segment; a Tardis capture gap outside an evaluation window may start a new segment only when followed by a generated full_snapshot that replaces the entire prior book; any gap during an evaluation window is a blocking failure

change_semantics.modify_order: old_size/new_size are total intended quantities including already executed quantity; new remaining = new_size - (old_size - current remaining)
change_semantics.remainder_after_modification: runtime-observed Coinbase subtype; old_size/new_size are current remainder before/after and old_price/new_price move the resting remainder
change_semantics.STP: official size-decrease subtype at payload.price; queue priority retained
change_semantics.resting_id_seen_as_taker: record taker matches while the ID is also reconstructed as resting; reconcile the old level only at a following remainder_after_modification or authoritative done. A filled done removes any residual as trade depletion, never A_visible or H_hidden

l3_truth.bug_fix_policy: any methodology-changing bug fix must record reason, impact, affected dates and rerun all dates

models.name: STRUCTURAL_ALPHA
models.alpha_source: calibration dates only, optionally globally adjusted using validation dates, frozen before test

models.name: TOUCH_FILL
models.rule: first executable trade ignores queue position

structural_calibration.C_i: L2-observed nontrade depletion at the placement price before expiry
structural_calibration.A_visible_i: L3-observed ahead cancellation, same-price size decrease, and old-level depletion caused by an ahead order moving to another price; classified from event semantics with no min(A,C) clipping
structural_calibration.H_hidden_i: same-price size-increase FIFO priority reset and any other L3-only priority loss without aggregate L2 old-level depletion; diagnostic only and forbidden as an L2 model input
structural_calibration.formula: alpha_visible = sum(A_visible_i) / sum(C_i) on calibration dates only
structural_calibration.hidden_priority_loss_share: sum(H_hidden_i) / sum(total_observed_L3_ahead_reduction_i), where total includes trade, cancellation, size-decrease, price-change-away, and hidden priority loss; diagnostic only
structural_calibration.C_zero_handling: C_i=0 observations contribute zero to numerator and denominator and are excluded from per-observation ratios
structural_calibration.bounds: require exact Decimal 0 <= A_visible_i <= C_i per event and virtual-order window; no clipping is permitted; any violation blocks the run

primary_metrics.normalized_fill_quantity_mae: mean(abs(predicted quantity - truth quantity) / virtual size)

aggregation.inference: effect sizes and date stability; no forced p-values
aggregation.bootstrap: date-block bootstrap confidence intervals only when enough dates exist

oracle_policy: per-test-date best alpha and full-sample best alpha may appear only as ORACLE / IN-SAMPLE REFERENCE ONLY and never as primary results
